about: G8BOM price table for the Assembly bill of materials (scripts/build/assembly_bom.gd). USD. 'materials': made parts, priced by mass (price_per_kg) with the density in kg/m3 (NOT g/cm3: 1.24 g/cm3 is 1240 kg/m3) and the strength / stiffness the cheaper view checks against a part's needs. 'items': bought parts and stock, priced per unit ('pcs', 'm', 'set', 'pair', 'lot'). Every entry has a 'source' and a 'date' (when the price was set); a source that starts with ASSUMED is a typical retail number nobody quoted: replace it with what you pay (keep the date honest). The CH14 numbers are the CH14 lane's own (scripts/build/ch14_bom.gd PRICE, ch14_arm.gd MAT; docs/CH14_REFERENCE.md section 6 for the material values).
